description: This file defines the S3SignatureV4 class which provides Amazon S3 signature version 4 support, including request signing and presigning functionalities specific to S3, with custom handling for access points and path normalization.

classes.name: S3SignatureV4
classes.description: Provides Amazon S3 signature version 4 signing and presigning support, with custom handling for access points and path normalization.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request with AWS credentials, adding necessary headers and handling special host cases.

methods.name: signWithV4a
methods.description: Performs V4a signing with custom configuration, including region and service specifics.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a pre-signed URL for a request, adding headers for data integrity and region set.

methods.name: getPresignedPayload
methods.description: Returns a constant indicating an unsigned payload for pre-signed URLs.

methods.name: createCanonicalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a canonical path for signing, removing a leading slash if present.
